description: This file contains C source code related to Windows file system monitoring, including functions to check remote protocol information and determine if a filesystem path is remote.

methods.name: int check_remote_protocol(wchar_t * wpath)
methods.description: Checks the remote protocol information of a directory at a given wide-character path by opening the handle and retrieving protocol info.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__get_fs_info(const char * path,struct fs_info * fs_info)
methods.description: Determines if a given path refers to a remote filesystem by checking the drive type and, if remote, verifying the protocol info.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__is_fs_remote(const char * path)
methods.description: Returns whether the given path points to a remote filesystem by calling fsmonitor__get_fs_info.
